# Penapis Air Kesihatan

Official website: https://penapisairkesihatan.my

Penapis Air Kesihatan is a local business selling and servicing RO and mineral water-filter systems and water dispensers, with service for indoor and outdoor home water filters. It also helps with product selection, replacement-filter checks and existing/older systems at 84, Jalan Intan 12, Taman Cahaya Masai, 81700 Pasir Gudang, Johor, Malaysia. The business can be contacted at +60 17-710 6169 or info@penapisairkesihatan.my.

The business is operated by CAHAYA SUKMAR (JM0510596X / 200803055593), registered in Johor and commenced on 24 March 2008.

Owner records include water containers within the registered business activities. Current product types, brands and stock must be confirmed directly before purchase or travel.

Service compatibility is checked by brand, model, photos, condition, required parts and location. The business does not promise that every brand or model can be serviced.
